messages:
Rae C: Quick raw capture from AtlasMed onboarding call this morning — dropping feature asks + enablement needs for triage.

Jon P: paste please. any renewal wording?

Rae C: Short list (customer quotes inline):
- Structured output enforcement: they need per-route schema validation so extractor returns the exact fields required for clinical workflows. Quote: "If the model returns free text we can't automate our downstream EHR mapping."
- Function-calling defaults: want ability to pin function-calling on/off per route and set trusted function whitelist.
- Per-route model pinning: sales/legal need to pin embedding + generator model per workspace for compliance.
- Admin onboarding roles: they asked for delegated admin roles (project admin vs org admin) and an invite flow for non-engineer admins.
- Enablement: want two 60-min enablement sessions + a one-page playbook template for doc-mapper best practices.

Mei L: Routing suggestion: schema & function-calling -> product-ml + serving; per-route model pinning & roles -> product/platform; enablement materials -> docs + devex.

Priya: Priority: mark schema enforcement + model pinning as P0 for AtlasMed (compliance + pilot roll). Admin roles + enablement P1. Requesting "renewal_watch" tag because they said they'd need these before the pilot expands next quarter.

Rae C: Customer sample for schema enforcement they shared (they prefer strict JSON):
```json
{
  "patient_id": "string",
  "procedure_code": "string",
  "consent_obtained": true,
  "notes": "string"
}
```
They want a hard fail or structured error when required keys missing.

Jon P: For function calling sticky defaults: propose config: route.default_function_calling = {enabled: true, whitelist: ["parse_report","extract_meds"]} — product, is this feasible?

product-bot: Created CS-6011: AtlasMed feature request — schema enforcement + per-route function defaults (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-6011)
product-bot: Created CS-6012: AtlasMed admin roles + enablement plan (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-6012)

Mei L: Customer language to capture: "We need a deterministic output contract or we can't adopt at scale." Marking account: onboarding_at_risk, renewal_watch.

Priya: Suggested prioritization weights for Friday sync: renewal_risk=3, compliance_impact=3, eng_effort_est=2, enablement_effort=1. We'll surface CS-6011/CS-6012.

Rae C: Action items:
- Rae -> upload call transcript & sample payload to CS-6011 (today EOD)
- Jon -> draft config proposal for function-calling defaults and per-route pinning (tomorrow)
- Mei -> draft a one-pager playbook template and coordinate two enablement sessions (next week)

enablement-bot: Scheduled enablement session placeholder: AtlasMed - Enablement Session 1 (2026-09-10 16:00 UTC)

Jon P: Small engineering note: we should add a lightweight eval in Optimize that checks route outputs against the schema and alerts on failure rate > 1%.

Rae C: Customer follow-up quote: "If we can't lock output format we won't complete our pilot expansion." I sent an acknowledgement and ETA.

Priya: I'll add these items to the product sync deck and flag CS-6011 as renewal-impacting.

Mei L: I'll start the playbook draft and share a link in CS-6012.

Rae C: Thanks team — keeping this high touch. :pray:
